shots.vo: Brian tiene 21 años. Afuera hay 35 grados bajo cero. Adentro, un cuarto alquilado con una estufa que no calienta.
shots.prompt: Brian sitting on the edge of a narrow bed in a tiny rented room at night, still wearing his work jacket indoors, breath faintly visible, thick frost covering the single window, a small electric heater glowing weakly on the floor, one bare bulb
shots.motion: he rubs his hands together slowly, his breath fogs, the heater glows and dims

shots.vo: Trabaja en construcción. No tiene carro. No tiene un peso en el banco. La chaqueta es la misma de hace cuatro inviernos.
shots.prompt: Brian walking alone at dawn along a snow-covered road toward a construction site, hands deep in the pockets of his frayed jacket, shoulders hunched against the wind, a bus passing him without stopping, gray sky, deep snow
shots.motion: he walks into the wind, the bus passes and throws up snow, he keeps walking

shots.vo: Lo echaron del colegio. No terminó. Esa noche se sienta en la cama y mira el cuarto: la pared, la ventana congelada, la maleta que lleva un año sin desempacar.
shots.prompt: Brian's point of view from the bed: a stained wall with peeling paint, the frost-covered window, and an old brown suitcase on the floor still closed with a coat thrown over it, the bare bulb's weak light, dead quiet
shots.motion: the camera drifts slowly across the wall to the window to the suitcase and holds

shots.vo: Y busca. A quién culpar. A su papá. Al colegio. Al frío. Al país. A la suerte.
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of Brian's face in the weak light, jaw tight, eyes moving as if going through a list, a muscle in his cheek working, frost glittering on the window behind him out of focus
shots.motion: his eyes shift from side to side, his jaw tightens, he swallows

shots.vo: Y no encuentra a nadie. Y por primera vez en su vida... se asusta de verdad.
shots.prompt: Brian leaning forward on the edge of the bed with his elbows on his knees and both hands over his mouth, staring at the floor, the realization landing on his face, the heater's orange glow on one side, cold blue window light on the other
shots.motion: his hands slide slowly down from his mouth, he stares at the floor, very still

shots.vo: Se lo dice en voz alta, para oírlo. Si algo va a cambiar... me toca a mí.
shots.prompt: Brian standing now in the middle of the tiny room, looking straight into the camera, jacket zipped, the frost window behind him, the suitcase at his feet finally open, the same tired eyes but steady, weak bulb light on his face
shots.motion: he looks straight into the camera and gives the smallest nod, the light holds steady

description:
Brian Tracy a los 21 años: un cuarto alquilado, 35 grados bajo cero, trabajo en construcción, sin carro, sin un peso en el banco, expulsado del colegio. Esa noche buscó a quién culpar. No encontró a nadie. Y dijo en voz alta: si algo va a cambiar, me toca a mí. Hoy ha vendido millones de libros.

LEYES DE LA MENTE es una serie de BiiA LAB: siete leyes que gobiernan tu vida, creas en ellas o no. Cap. 2: la ley de la responsabilidad.
